purpose: Repair the applicability domain of the Q2-5 biasing benchmark after the root-cause investigation found that the factor-10 configuration is not a valid physical equivalence test for this charged-particle case. This r2 benchmark narrows the case to factor 1.2 with a symmetric 0.01 mm maximum step in the sensitive target. It is not a fix for all charged-particle occurrence-biasing systematic errors.

original_data.policy: kept byte-identical; r2 never overwrites or backfills it

findings_reused: all 4095 issued primary steps satisfy log(wpost/wpre) = (sigma_b - sigma_a)*step_length - log(f) at eBrem occurrence; no simple missing survival weight or counting error
independent seeds factor 1.2 with the original step size: dose ratio 0.974554949, Welch 99% CI [-3.48979e-12, -2.03468e-12] (still low)
symmetric 0.01 mm region max_step, 8+8 independent batches: ratio 1.000044886, Welch 99% CI [-1.451914e-12, 1.461625e-12] (diagnostic only)
root_investigation.limits: The diagnostic cannot backfill the original 32 batches and does not prove universal unbiasedness.

configuration.case: 10 MeV electrons, 10 mm G4_Pb cube, G4_Galactic world, point source at origin +z, FTFP_BERT, cut 0.1 mm, dose+hits+event_edep
configuration.difference_between_groups: physics.biasing and the [biasing.*] rule only; both groups carry the same 0.01 mm target region step limit

criterion.primary: single Welch 99% two-sided mean-difference interval on per-completed-event weighted dose (Gy/event), equal batch counts per group
criterion.decision_semantics: detected if the interval excludes zero; compatible otherwise; compatibility at this resolution is not equivalence or unbiasedness
criterion.ci_relative_width_rule: half_width / analog batch mean; if greater than 0.05 the campaign is insufficient to sign off even this limited case and is reported as limited
criterion.efficiency: report real host wall time per batch and the scorer's run_wall_time_s plus FOM; a slow or no-gain result is a valid result and is not hidden

stopping.failure_action: stop the campaign, retain the failure, report it; do not silently replace with the remaining batches

explicitly_forbidden: changing the production ParticleHit pre-step weight to a post-step or midpoint weight
calibrating dose with the diagnostic mean
claiming 0.01 mm as a universal guarantee
using this r2 outcome for other particles, other factors, neutral particles or the original factor-10 result
modifying production statistics formulas, physics algorithms, global default step length, frozen evidence or the original 32 batches

applicability.signoff_scope: only this repaired 10 MeV electron / G4_Pb / 10 mm factor-1.2 case with the stated target step upper bound
applicability.not_claimed: elimination of all charged-particle occurrence-biasing systematic errors; physical unbiasedness of factor-10; equivalence of analog and biased transport
applicability.known_limits: the 59% factor-10 discrepancy is not fully decomposed; this repair changes configuration and applicability statements, not the production physics
